en: Proverbs 13

p.src: 1  A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

ja: に耳を傾けるが、 あざける
は叱責に耳を貸さない。
en: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
u.src: 1  A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

p.src: 2  By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

en: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
u.src: 2  By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

p.src: 3  He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

en: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
u.src: 3  He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

p.src: 4  The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

ja: の願いは十分に満たされる。
en: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
u.src: 4  The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

p.src: 5  A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

en: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
u.src: 5  A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

p.src: 6  Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

en: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
u.src: 6  Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

p.src: 7  There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

ja: んでいるふりをしても、
en: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
u.src: 7  There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

p.src: 8  The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

ja: の命を贖うものはその富であるが、
en: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
u.src: 8  The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

p.src: 9  The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

en: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
u.src: 9  The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

p.src: 10  Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

ja: むだけだが、 助言を受け入れる
en: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
u.src: 10  Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

p.src: 11  Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

ja: っていくが、 少しずつ手で
en: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
u.src: 11  Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

p.src: 12  Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

ja: みが先延ばしにされると、
いがかなえられると、それは
en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
u.src: 12  Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

p.src: 13  Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

ja: はその代償を払い、 命令を重んじる
en: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
u.src: 13  Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

p.src: 14  The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

en: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
u.src: 14  The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

p.src: 15  Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

ja: りは好意をもたらすが、 不実な
en: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
u.src: 15  Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

p.src: 16  Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

en: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
u.src: 16  Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

p.src: 17  A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

ja: るが、 信頼できる使節は癒やしをもたらす。
en: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
u.src: 17  A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

p.src: 18  Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

en: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
u.src: 18  Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

p.src: 19  Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

ja: いがかなうことは心に
en: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
u.src: 19  Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

p.src: 20  One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

en: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
u.src: 20  One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

p.src: 21  Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

ja: いかけるが、 幸いは義
en: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
u.src: 21  Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

p.src: 22  A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

en: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
u.src: 22  A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

p.src: 23  An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

en: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
u.src: 23  An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

p.src: 24  One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

ja: は、注意を怠らず訓練する。
en: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
u.src: 24  One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

p.src: 25  The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

en: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
u.src: 25  The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
